title: Slack Personal Activity Message Count Leaderboard
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=slack:personal message_count=*
| stats sum(message_count) as total_value, avg(message_count) as avg_value by channel_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks channel values by total and average message count across Slack personal activity events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `message_count` values for each Slack personal activity event and review total and average message count by channel.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total message count.
grandmaExplanation: It helps you which channel shows the biggest message count numbers in your Slack personal activity data.
